records.source: Wool
records.translation: Lana

records.source: Soft, fluffy wool.
records.translation: Malambot at malagong lana.

records.source: Wriggling Worm
records.translation: Kumakawag na Uod

records.source: It's a wriggling, wet worm.
records.translation: Basa at kumakawag na uod ito.

records.source: Yam
records.translation: Kamote

records.source: A starchy tuber with a lot of culinary versatility.
records.translation: Ugat na hitik sa almirol at napakaraming gamit sa pagluluto.

records.source: Yam Seeds
records.translation: Mga Binhi ng Kamote

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 10 araw upang mahinog.

records.source: A receptacle of unknown origins...
records.translation: Sisidlang hindi alam ang pinagmulan...

records.source: It's a strange relic from another world.
records.translation: Kakaibang relikya ito mula sa ibang mundo.

records.source: I don't have the chops to catch squid, but that's fine. I'll just cheer you on from here, kid.
records.translation: Wala akong husay para manghuli ng pusit, pero ayos lang. Dito na lang kita susuportahan, bata.

records.source: After a while, you get a feel for the squid's behavior. You can tell when one's on the line before you even see it.
records.translation: Pagkaraan ng ilang panahon, makakasanayan mo ang kilos ng pusit. Malalaman mong may kumagat bago mo pa ito makita.

records.source: I'm glad you fixed up the bus! This is really fun.$h#$e#I've always wanted to travel beyond Pelican Town.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong inayos mo ang bus! Talagang masaya ito.$h#$e#Noon ko pa gustong maglakbay sa labas ng Bayan ng Pelican.

records.source: I was thinking of joining you in the skull caves, but then I saw the food stand...#$e#You go on ahead without me... just be careful!
records.translation: Balak sana kitang samahan sa Yungib ng Bungo, pero nakita ko ang puwesto ng pagkain...#$e#Mauna ka na nang wala ako... mag-ingat ka lang!

records.source: Hey... you look really cute in the desert sun...$h
records.translation: Hoy... ang ganda mo sa ilalim ng araw sa disyerto...$h

records.source: Hey, don't forget to pick up our free cactus before the festival ends.#$b#Whatever it looks like, it's gonna be perfect in our house!$h
records.translation: Hoy, huwag kalimutang kunin ang libre nating kaktus bago matapos ang pista.#$b#Anuman ang hitsura nito, magiging perpekto iyon sa bahay natin!$h

records.source: Hey, I'll just stay here and relax in the shade.#$e#You know how I am... I've always been more of a cave dweller.$h
records.translation: Hoy, mananatili lang ako rito at magpapahinga sa lilim.#$e#Kilala mo ako... mas sanay talaga akong tumira sa kuweba.$h

records.source: Remind me to brush my teeth tonight... there's twelve unique soda flavors, and I'm on track to try them all.#$e#Mmm... cave carrot soda... *slurp*
records.translation: Paalalahanan mo akong magsipilyo mamayang gabi... may labindalawang natatanging lasa ng soda, at mukhang matitikman ko silang lahat.#$e#Mmm... soda ng Karot sa Yungib... *higop*
records.englishResidueReason: Soda is a conventional Filipino beverage loanword.

records.source: Well well well, what have we here? A beautiful desert rose!$h#$e#Make sure to stay watered, dear.
records.translation: Aba, aba, aba, ano itong narito? Isang magandang rosas ng disyerto!$h#$e#Tiyaking lagi kang nadidiligan, mahal.

records.source: Hey, @. I'll be working late during the festival, so don't wait up for me at night!#$e#Promise me you'll be careful in the skull caves.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Magtatrabaho ako nang gabi sa pista, kaya huwag mo akong hintayin!#$e#Ipangako mong mag-iingat ka sa Yungib ng Bungo.

records.source: Hey, @! I love you just the way you are... but if you want, you can step inside the box too!
records.translation: Hoy, @! Mahal kita kung ano ka man... pero kung gusto mo, maaari ka ring pumasok sa kahon!

records.source: I've been having fun, but I'm so busy I haven't been able to do any chores at home. I hope you're doing okay!
records.translation: Masaya ako rito, pero abalang-abala kaya wala akong nagagawang gawain sa bahay. Sana ay maayos ka!

records.source: I can't remember... did I feed the parrot this morning?
records.translation: Hindi ko maalala... pinakain ko ba ang loro kaninang umaga?

records.source: Hey... looks like someone's got a nice tan going... *pinch*$h
records.translation: Hoy... mukhang may magandang kayumangging balat ang isang tao... *kurot*$h

records.source: %Your wife is taking a nap.
records.translation: %Umidlip ang asawa mo.

records.source: Hi, honey. I'm just browsing to see if there's anything nice for the house.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Tumitingin lang ako kung may magandang bagay para sa bahay.$h

records.source: How's the Calico Egg collection coming along? There's so many cool prizes!$h#$e#I know you'll do great.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pangongolekta mo ng mga Itlog ng Calico? Napakaraming magagandang premyo!$h#$e#Alam kong magtatagumpay ka.

records.source: I wanted to go swimming, but apparently the water's full of scorpion carp!$h
records.translation: Gusto ko sanang lumangoy, pero punô pala ng Karpang Alakdan ang tubig!$h

records.source: Have you seen the size of these Calico Eggs?#$b#Just imagine the protein...
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang laki ng mga Itlog ng Calico na ito?#$b#Isipin mo na lang ang protina...

records.source: This weather is just perfect. I can't tell where my skin ends and the air begins.$h
records.translation: Perpekto ang panahon. Hindi ko malaman kung saan nagtatapos ang balat ko at nagsisimula ang hangin.$h

records.source: Hey, @. To tell you the truth, I don't really like festivals.#$b#But I'd feel even worse if I stayed at home, knowing that everyone else was out here having fun.$s
records.translation: Hoy, @. Sa totoo lang, hindi ko talaga gusto ang mga pista.#$b#Pero mas masama ang pakiramdam ko kung manatili ako sa bahay habang alam kong nagsasaya rito ang lahat.$s

records.source: Why do humans enjoy spicy food? It's counter-intuitive from a biological perspective.#$e#Unless there's something I'm missing...$5
records.translation: Bakit nasisiyahan ang mga tao sa maanghang na pagkain? Salungat iyon sa inaasahan mula sa pananaw ng biyolohiya.#$e#Maliban kung may hindi ako nauunawaan...$5

records.source: *mumble* ...hmm, the toe-feel is milky, but with plenty of body. Still, a bit mellower than back home...#$b#Oh, pardon me! I've become something of a sand connoisseur.$h
records.translation: *bulong* ...hmm, malagatas ang haplos sa mga daliri ng paa ngunit may sapat na bigat. Gayunman, mas banayad nang kaunti kaysa sa amin...#$b#O, paumanhin! Para na akong dalubhasa sa buhangin.$h

records.source: Hmm... I'm sensing that your fashion doesn't quite match your inner feeling. Just step in the box and we'll fix you up!
records.translation: Hmm... Nararamdaman kong hindi gaanong tumutugma ang pananamit mo sa damdamin mo. Pumasok ka lang sa kahon at aayusin ka namin!

records.source: Ah... the sands of time, the sands of time...
records.translation: Ah... ang buhangin ng panahon, ang buhangin ng panahon...

records.source: What is she mumbling about? I'm here for the spicy food tent!
records.translation: Ano ang ibinubulong niya? Narito ako para sa tolda ng maanghang na pagkain!

records.source: Normally I provide all the food for town festivals. But not today! It's nice to be able to relax.$h
records.translation: Karaniwan, ako ang naghahanda ng lahat ng pagkain sa mga pista ng bayan. Pero hindi ngayon! Masarap ding makapagpahinga.$h

records.source: If you smell something good, it's the coconut oil I rubbed all over my skin.#$b#I'm going 'all in' with the desert feeling!$h
records.translation: Kung may naaamoy kang mabango, iyon ang langis ng niyog na ipinahid ko sa buong balat ko.#$b#Lubos kong sinasabayan ang pakiramdam ng disyerto!$h

records.source: %Haley is glistening in the sunlight.
records.translation: %Kumikinang si Haley sa sikat ng araw.

records.source: This is fun, but I wish I had an ice cream...
records.translation: Masaya ito, pero sana may sorbetes ako...
